answers.rationale: Requirement 1 outlines general standards and quality expectations for equipment and materials, but does not specify a particular product or business unit. It is a general guideline for the bid manager to ensure compliance with quality standards.

Requirement 2 involves termination of field control and indication cables, as well as connection of overhead buswork and grounds. ANORD-BUSWAY is suitable for overhead busway distribution, which aligns with the requirement for connection of buswork and grounds.
